id: title:TueHaulund:cap rasterizer input size and quarantine worker killers

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a size-gate and dedicated worker for recording rasterization, potentially preventing memory exhaustion and isolating failures.
review.reason: Adds a byte-cap configuration and a size-gate before loading recording blocks, and a dedicated worker for the rasterization activity. This could help prevent memory exhaustion and isolate failures, but the exact benefit and implementation are not fully demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit and implementation are not fully demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are used. No tier is assigned; score is withheld.

observations.behavior: Adds a byte-cap configuration and a size-gate before loading recording blocks.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks compressed byte total before loading blocks; if non-numeric, skips the size gate and warns; otherwise, rejects oversized recordings before loading the pod.

observations.behavior: Adds a new property to BlockProxy to compute total compressed bytes of recording blocks.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the compressed byte total used by the size gate; each block's byte span is end - start + 1.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error code for oversized recordings and its handling in the workflow.
observations.posthog_connection: Raises RECORDING_TOO_LARGE before loading the recording, avoiding memory exhaustion and pod-wide failures.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a synthetic failure path and a dedicated worker for the rasterization activity, while retaining the original worker for other activities.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the test setup to use a multi-worker context, separating the rasterization activity into its own worker, while retaining the original worker for other activities.
